data.detailed_description: "Amphi-Trekking" Adventure in Chimmony Wildlife Sanctuary! Experience the best of both land and water with our unique "Amphi-Trekking" program at Chimmony Wildlife Sanctuary! This single, exciting itinerary combines a refreshing trek through the sanctuary's beautiful landscapes with a traditional coracle ride, which offering a truly immersive way to explore this natural paradise. Trek & Coracle Ride Details: Distance: 8 km (Trekking) Duration: 5 hours Difficulty: Soft to Moderate Starting Time: 7:00 AM Discover Chimmony by Land and Water: Chimmony Wildlife Sanctuary, nestled in the Western Ghats of Kerala, is renowned for its lush forests, diverse wildlife, and the serene Chimmony Dam. Your "Amphi-Trekking" adventure will begin with a gentle to moderate trek through the sanctuary's verdant trails, allowing you to immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the forest. Keep an eye out for the sanctuary's vibrant birdlife and diverse plant species. The trek will lead you to the tranquil waters, where the second part of your adventure begins – a delightful coracle ride. Glide across the calm waters, taking in panoramic views of the surrounding hills and dense forests, offering a unique perspective of the sanctuary's beauty. Inclusions: Your "Amphi-Trekking" package ensures a hassle-free and enjoyable experience: Sanctuary Entry Fee Mineral Water Snacks Lunch Booking Information: Ticket Charge: ₹800/- per person Minimum Requirement: 6 persons (or a minimum payment of ₹4800/-) Pre-booking is essential. To book your "Amphi-Trekking" adventure, please call: 8547603459 Get ready for an unforgettable blend of trekking and boating amidst the breathtaking natural beauty of Chimmony Wildlife Sanctuary!
data.description: Chimmony Wildlife Sanctuary, nestled in the Western Ghats of Thrissur district is a hidden gem for nature lovers. This pristine sanctuary boasts lush tropical rainforests, cascading waterfalls, and diverse wildlife, making it a perfect destination for trekking, birdwatching, and wildlife spotting. The sanctuary is home to dense evergreen and semi-evergreen forests, providing a habitat for a variety of flora and fauna. Visitors can enjoy trekking, cycling, turtle ride, offered by the Kerala Forest Department.
